components.name: Primary action
components.css: .ds-primary {font-family: var(--font-sans); text-decoration: none; display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:var(--action);color:var(--on-action);padding:.95rem 1.5rem;border-radius:var(--radius);font-weight:700;min-height:46px;box-sizing:border-box;line-height:1.4;transition:background .18s ease} .ds-primary:hover {background:var(--action-hover)} .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action); outline-offset: 2px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){[class^="ds-"]{transition-duration:.01ms!important}}

components.name: Legacy primary action
components.description: Gold-named class retains the green palette and slight hover lift.
components.css: .ds-legacy {font-family: var(--font-sans); text-decoration: none; background:var(--action);color:var(--on-action);border:0;padding:.95rem 1.5rem;border-radius:var(--radius);font-weight:700;font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.4;min-height:46px;transition:background .18s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),transform .18s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)} .ds-legacy:hover {background:var(--action-hover);transform:translateY(-1px)} .ds-legacy:active {transform:translateY(0)} .ds-legacy:disabled {opacity:.65;cursor:wait} .ds-legacy:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action); outline-offset: 2px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){[class^="ds-"]{transition-duration:.01ms!important}}

components.name: Ghost action
components.description: Secondary destination with a quiet outline.
components.css: .ds-ghost {font-family: var(--font-sans); text-decoration: none; display:inline-flex;border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--foreground);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:.95rem 1.5rem;font-weight:600;font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.4;min-height:46px;box-sizing:border-box;transition:border-color .18s ease,background .18s ease} .ds-ghost:hover {border-color:var(--muted-foreground);background:var(--secondary)} .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action); outline-offset: 2px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){[class^="ds-"]{transition-duration:.01ms!important}}

narrative.northStar: An ocean world. A steady hand. A clear next move.
narrative.overview:
Career Maniacs uses open water, wide Archivo headlines and direct human language. The original wave logo anchors a teal, green and blue identity; sea-glass green identifies the next action. Opaque ocean surfaces carry reading-heavy content.

The homepage moves from calm animated sunrise water to an illustrative breaking wave for Position, Story and Close, then returns to calm water with a higher sun. This is the implemented expression of the owner-approved direction, not a new shader animation. The public /style-guide page shares the live site tokens. Use bold, specific copy: “Stop blending in. Start closing.” A Maniac prepares relentlessly, stays curious and commits fully. Shared BrandLogo places the original wave before the wordmark on one horizontal line.
keyCharacteristics: Original wave identity, preserved without redrawing.
Wide headlines and readable all-sans body copy.
Ocean imagery around opaque reading surfaces.
Visible native controls, ordinary scrolling and reduced-motion alternatives.

rules.name: The Sea Glass Rule
rules.body: Use the action token for the main next step. Sunrise warmth belongs to the ocean imagery.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Use self-hosted Archivo throughout; the story voice is normal sans-serif, not serif italic.

rules.name: The Reading Surface Rule
rules.body: Put dense copy on opaque ocean surfaces and let the ocean carry the opening, method and closing chapters.

rules.name: The Native Action Rule
rules.body: Use links for destinations and buttons for state changes or submission; keep labels and focus states visible.

dos: Do preserve the original logo artwork and its teal, green and blue palette.
Do use sea-glass action color for the main next step and keep sunrise warmth in imagery.
Do keep native links, labeled form controls, visible focus and motion alternatives.
Do label the generated wave and example interview answer as illustrative where provenance or meaning is explained.
Do keep Career Maniacs and GTM Maniacs distinct.
donts: Don't reintroduce gold primary actions or a decorative serif voice.
Don't redraw the logo, convert whole-page navigation to scripted buttons, or trap scrolling.
Don't make dense reading sections transparent over the sun.
Don't describe an accepted inquiry as a scheduled call or a generated wave as documentary photography.
